label: Diagram 8.4
caption: Diagram 8.4 Uninsulated glazed screen separating protected shaft from lobby or corridor
description: This drawing is a floor plan, titled in a green banner at the bottom "Diagram 8.4 Uninsulated glazed screen separating protected shaft from lobby or corridor", with the text "paras 8.34 and 8.35" at the top left. It has two parts shown side by side, each a rectangular plan with thick external walls. Part a, labelled "a. With corridor", shows a "Corridor" on the left and a "Protected shaft" on the right (the shaft contains a gridded window-like shape at its top); the vertical line between them is the "Uninsulated glazed screen (minimum RE 30)", with three green curved door symbols. Part b, labelled "b. With lobby", shows an unlabelled space on the left, a "Protected shaft" at the top right and a "Protected lobby" at the bottom right, the shaft and lobby divided by a horizontal line; the "Uninsulated glazed screen (minimum RE 30)" is the vertical line on the left of the shaft and lobby, separating them from the unlabelled space, again with three green door symbols. A legend on the right defines the line types: "External wall"; "Fire resistance of protected shaft to be a maximum of REI 60"; "Fire resistance of construction to be a minimum of REI 30"; "Fire resistance of glazed screen to be a minimum of RE 30"; and the green curve as "Fire doorsets that are a minimum of E 30 S".
